name: PlanBench
description: PlanBench is an extensible benchmark designed to evaluate the planning abilities of large language models (LLMs) and large reasoning models (LRMs) by assessing their capability to plan a course of action to achieve desired outcomes.
reputation: PlanBench has been an important tool since 2022 for evaluating planning abilities of LLMs and remains relevant with new models like OpenAI's o1.
notes: PlanBench was originally developed in 2022 and continues to be used for benchmarking planning capabilities of LLMs and LRMs.
